comment: C-36 round 3: resolver work counters on a cold index, main (the code of origin/main, 60d4f2b) against the round-2 head (44b978e) and the round-3 head. Counters were inserted the same way in each tree by an experiment-only patch: lookups = calls of find(), lookupComputes = calls of lookupPath() (memo misses), lazyComputes = lazy-cache computations (main: answers stored, the heads: every computation), cuts = cycle cuts and helper re-entries. One process each, in-thread, in parallel; counts do not depend on load. cpuS are observations on a shared server.

cpuObservations.comment: cold-cost.mjs, alternating, separate processes, shared server (load average 25-47); not cost evidence
